world: OP1: on which coordinates should a Koopman dictionary be built. D8's forced two-dimensional turbulence (Kolmogorov forcing k_f = 4, drag alpha, pseudo-spectral RK4), one training and one independent test trajectory per world. The consumer reads the pairs |k| <= k_c; the pool is k_c < |k| <= k_pool. Rankings READ (read distortion for the consumer), ENERGY, BALL (graded controls), SENS (recorded), RANDOM (null); records POD, GREEDY (linear lift), NONE, PERSIST. Lifts LIN, RFF and TEND (the linear dictionary plus the consumer tendency on the chosen pairs); ridge EDMD; Koopman forecasts of the consumer at the declared horizons; graded value the mean over horizons of min(e_h, cap).
